name: North Carolina

agency.name: North Carolina Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Bureau

rates2026.note: Unchanged throughout 2026; equals the federal minimum

tipped.note: Tips must bring the employee to at least $7.25; employees must be notified in advance and keep all tips

minWage.other: Agricultural and domestic employees are subject to the federal minimum wage.

source.quote: The minimum wage in North Carolina is currently $7.25 an hour.

overtime.note: Seasonal amusement/recreation businesses: overtime after 45 hours (per dol.gov table).

source.quote: time and one-half overtime pay based on an employee's regular rate of pay for all hours worked in excess of 40 in a workweek unless the employee is exempt

sickLeave.note: No state paid sick leave requirement; sick leave is a promised wage benefit only if the employer offers it.

source.quote: an employer is not required by law to give mandatory wage benefits such as vacation pay, sick leave, jury duty pay, and holiday pay

finalPay.fired: on or before the next regular payday
finalPay.quit: on or before the next regular payday
finalPay.ptoNote: Earned vacation must be paid at separation unless the employer has a written forfeiture clause notified to employees.

source.quote: Employees whose employment is discontinued for any reason shall be paid all wages due on or before the next regular payday

ptoSource.quote: Earned vacation pay, commissions, and bonuses cannot be forfeited unless the employer has a written forfeiture clause in its vacation, commission, or bonus policy

breaks.minorsOnly: Under 16: at least a 30-minute break after 5 hours of work

source.quote: does not require mandatory rest breaks or meal breaks for employees 16 years of age or older. The WHA requires breaks only for youths under 16

rightToWorkSource.quote: the right of persons to work shall not be denied or abridged on account of membership or nonmembership in any labor union or labor organization

notes.text: Employers must grant parents of school-age children 4 hours of (unpaid) leave per year to attend or be involved at the child's school.

source.quote: employers shall grant four hours per year leave to any employee who is a parent, guardian, or person standing in loco parentis of a school-aged child

notes.text: Any break shorter than 30 minutes (such as a 15-minute rest break) generally must be paid.

source.quote: Generally, breaks of less than 30 minutes, such as a 15-minute rest break, have to be paid by the employer.
